card.name: Physics of forces, tension and distance
card.fires_on: Words in physics text about forces, tension, ropes, strings and lifting, such as 'Distance' in 'action at a distance', 'in' after tension, and 'string' or 'rope' under load. Also shipping text about cargo moved by sea.
